findings.explanation: Payment terms of up to 45 days after invoice issuance delay your cash flow beyond the standard 30-day period.
findings.suggested_change: Except for article 3.1 hereabove, payments shall be made by wire transfer to the bank nominated by Licensor, within thirty (30) days after the issuance by the Licensor of the corresponding invoices,

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. Thank you for sharing the agreement. I would like to request a minor modification before signing. - Regarding the payment terms in the relevant clause, a period of 45 days delays cash flow, so I propose updating the timeline to thirty days with the following wording: Except for article 3.1 hereabove, payments shall be made by wire transfer to the bank nominated by Licensor, within thirty (30) days after the issuance of the corresponding invoices. Please let me know if this change is acceptable. Best regards
